entries.speaker: Mid-Battle Party Change
entries.en: Hifumi Togo's Confidant Ability [clr 1]Koma Sabaki[clr 27][n]allows you to switch out party members[n]mid-battle.

entries.speaker: Mid-Battle Party Change
entries.en: On [fName]'s turn, you can select who to[n]switch in by pressing [clr 2][f 1 10 50][clr 27] and selecting[n][clr 2]Party[clr 27] from the [clr 2]Order[clr 27] menu.

entries.speaker: Mid-Battle Party Change
entries.en: [clr 2]Switching out party members will count as[clr 27][n][clr 2][fName]'s action for that particular turn.[clr 27][n]Also, you cannot switch out an afflicted[n]teammate.
